# MAYEM YOTA TAMESSUING Julios — Portfolio

> Software developer (software engineering, databases, business applications, facial recognition), based in Yaoundé, Cameroon.
> Also known as: Julios Mayem, Mayem Julios.

## About

MAYEM YOTA TAMESSUING Julios is a software developer based in Yaoundé, Cameroon.
Education: DUT in computer engineering, IUT of Ngaoundéré (with honours), then a professional bachelor's degree in software engineering from IUSTE, Yaoundé (highest honours, ranked first in class).
He received the Presidential Excellence Award twice (2021, 2022).
Since 2024 he works at BkSquare SARL as a software developer and IT manager, hired after a research internship in facial recognition.

## Core expertise

- Software engineering and modelling (MERISE, 2TUP, UML)
- Databases (SQL, MySQL, SQLite, Firebase)
- Computer vision (Python, OpenCV, CustomTkinter)
- Mobile development (Flutter / Dart)
- CI/CD (Codemagic)

## Selected projects

### KKBSECU — Facial-recognition access control (BkSquare SARL, 2024)
Stack: Python, OpenCV, CustomTkinter, Firebase, 2TUP methodology.
Bachelor's thesis graded 19/20. In internal production use. Code not public.

### GESCOM — Sales management system
Stack: MERISE, MySQL. Till, invoicing, margins, stock management and out-of-stock alerts.
Role: design, MERISE modelling and development. Code not public.

### AfriDelight (project name: Delicio Food) — Restaurant finder mobile app (prototype, 2023)
Stack: Flutter, Dart, Google Maps, SQLite. Code not public.

### School showcase website — learning prototype (2023)
Stack: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, MySQL. Based on the case of IUSTE, with a pre-registration module. Code not public.

### Educational maths game (2022)
Stack: Python, SQLite. Calculation quizzes by difficulty level with scoring.

### AfriShape — Academic and career guidance platform (2026, team project)
Stack: Django, Python, HTML, CSS, JavaScript. Contributed to the design and back-end development.
Live at https://www.afrishape.org/. Code not public.
